liveHistoryDescription: View the history of all your past live streams.
updateAvailableDialogText: A new version is available, do you want to download it?
lowLatencyHelp: Asks the encoder for the smallest delay it can manage: no lookahead, no scenecut. Turn it off for a re-stream, where the pacing is already done downstream.
adaptiveBitrateHelp: When the network does not carry the live, the bitrate goes down to what it carries and climbs back after a few minutes of clean streaming. Off, the live always goes out at the bitrate above, whatever the network does.
tuningRequired: Without low latency the encoder is tuned by hand: choose a preset and a tune.
youtubeOffAirHelp: YouTube is receiving the stream, but the channel has no public live: Studio can rate it “excellent” and still not broadcast it. In YouTube Studio check that Auto-start is on (or press Go live), Auto-stop is off and the visibility is Public. If Studio stays on “Preparing stream”, YouTube gets the data but cannot process it: turn off Dual stream, and try “Publish with ffmpeg” in the channel settings.
youtubeUnverifiedHelp: Orbis cannot find the channel on YouTube, so it cannot tell whether the live is on air or warn you when it is not. In the channel settings, set the channel name to the YouTube handle (e.g. @yourchannel, as in youtube.com/@yourchannel) or to the channel ID (UC…).
ffmpegSenderHelp: ffmpeg keeps the live at real time and publishes it over its own RTMPS.
ingestFromDashboard: Kick and Facebook Gaming may give your account or your live a server address of its own: paste the one shown on your Kick dashboard or in Facebook Live Producer.
keyEachLiveHint: TikTok creates a new key for every live: it is not saved here, you will be asked for it each time you start a live. You find the server in TikTok LIVE Producer.
tiktokKeyHint: Copy it from TikTok LIVE Producer: it is valid for this live only and is not saved.
playSpotHint: Select the ad video to broadcast. The current stream will pause and automatically resume after the spot.
sceneDeckHint: Each button puts a video, a banner or an image on air in place of the live. A video goes back to the live when it ends; an image stays until you press “Resume live”.
sceneKeysHint: The keys work in Live management and Preview once this panel has been opened for the live, and always ask for confirmation.

sceneVideoBehaviour: Goes back to the live when it ends

sceneLocked: Open the scene panel to use the buttons and their keys on this live

sourceVolumesHint: How loud each video of the scene is in the live mix. 100% is its original sound.
encoderQualityHelp: How much work the encoder puts into every frame. Automatic: when the live starts Orbis tests this PC for a few seconds and uses Balanced (NVENC p4) only if the GPU or CPU keeps up with room to spare, Light (p1) otherwise. Light uses less but shows less detail at the same bitrate; High needs a powerful GPU or CPU. A preset chosen in the additional options takes precedence.
encoderQualityHint: Automatic tests this PC and decides by itself: keep it if you are not sure.
